human.controls: Arrows move. SPACE shoots or acts (games with a ShootAvatar or FlakAvatar).

reference.name: py-vgdl, Tsividis lineage, as used for the theory-based RL fMRI study (Tomov et al. 2023): tomov/RC_RL branch fmri, vgdl/ + fmri_all_games/
reference.block_size_note: BasicGame.buildLevel sets block_size = 30 unconditionally; the square_size header is ignored.
reference.step_semantics: RLEnvironmentNonStatic.step as driven by VGDLEnv (the DDQN wrapper): visualize=True so kills flush at the start of each action; softReset() performs one action-less step before the first agent action; actions are single keys [NOOP, RIGHT, LEFT, UP, DOWN, SPACE]; on NOOP the avatar is not updated at all.
reference.parity: full state every step: time, score, ended, won, and every live (non-kill-list) sprite's (type, x, y, resources incl. defaultdict zero entries); same seed (module random seeded before softReset) and action sequence; tests/gate_oracle_rcrl.mjs vs tests/oracle_rcrl.py
reference.group_order: abstract sprite groups are assembled in Python 2 dict order; <game>.groups.json captures it from the oracle and the bundle embeds it
not_matched: pixels (RC_RL draws 30px squares with pygame; PlayTrain draws fitted cells into a 64x64 frame) — colours are RC_RL's palette
reward: VGDLEnv returns +1/-1 on termination and the score delta otherwise; PlayTrain reports the score delta every step
the real-time human loop (core.tick, frame_rate 20, terminations checked before the update) is not the reference; the RL step is
the RNG: RC_RL's module-level random is unseeded, so the reference is only reproducible once seeded, which the oracle does
the host reset consumes one NOOP frame before the first agent action (PlayTrain draws and steps in the same frame)
